description:
You are a data engineer at a retail analytics company. The sales_etl project at ~/PycharmProjects/sales_etl/ is a Python ETL pipeline that processes daily transaction records from a CSV file, applies business logic transformations, and loads the results into a SQLite database for reporting.

Your QA team has reported that the nightly ETL run is producing incorrect results — the reporting dashboard is showing wrong figures for discount pricing and units sold. They have provided a failing test suite.

The project is already open in PyCharm. Run the test suite to see what is broken, investigate the root causes using the debugger, fix all bugs, and ensure the complete test suite passes.

Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.

Success condition: All 7 tests in the test suite must pass (pytest exit code 0).
